summary: This protocol enables anchors to accept off-chain assets in exchange for different on-chain assets, and vice versa. Specifically, it enables anchors to provide quotes that can be referenced within the context of existing Stellar Ecosystem Proposals. How the exchange of assets is facilitated is outside the scope of this document.

fields.name: assets
fields.description: An array of objects describing the assets available in exchange for one or more of the other assets listed.

fields.name: asset
fields.description: The [Asset Identification Format](#asset-identification-format) value.

fields.name: sell_delivery_methods
fields.description: (optional) Only for non-Stellar assets. An array of objects describing the methods a client can use to sell/deliver funds to the anchor. All methods listed here should match the `funding_methods` options specified in the protocol (E.g. [SEP-6] `GET /info`) where quote is being applied. The method of delivery may affect the expiration and/or price provided in a [`POST /quote`](#post-quote) response. If the delivery method is not necessary for providing accurate quotes and expirations, the server can omit this attribute.

fields.name: buy_delivery_methods
fields.description: (optional) Only for non-Stellar assets. An array of objects describing the methods a client can use to buy/retrieve funds from the anchor. All methods listed here should match the `funding_methods` options specified in the protocol (E.g. [SEP-6] `GET /info`) where quote is being applied. The method of delivery may affect the expiration and/or price provided in a [`POST /quote`](#post-quote) response. If the delivery method is not necessary for providing accurate quotes and expirations, the server can omit this attribute.

fields.name: country_codes
fields.description: (optional) Only for fiat assets. A list of [ISO 3166-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2) codes of the countries where the Anchor operates for fiat transactions. Anchor may not require second part of the ISO 3166-2 to be passed (i.e. use [ISO-3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) instead).

fields.name: name
fields.description: The value to use when making `POST /quote` requests.

fields.name: description
fields.description: A human readable description of the method identified by `name`.

fields.name: sell_asset
fields.description: The asset you want to sell, using the [Asset Identification Format](#asset-identification-format). If the `sell_asset` is defined, the `buy_asset` must not exist.

fields.name: buy_asset
fields.description: The asset you want to buy, using the [Asset Identification Format](#asset-identification-format). If the `buy_asset` is defined, the `sell_asset` must not exist.

fields.name: sell_amount
fields.description: The amount of `sell_asset` the client would exchange for each of the `buy_assets`. The `sell_amount` is valid only when the `sell_asset` is defined.

fields.name: buy_amount
fields.description: The amount of `buy_asset` the client would exchange for each of the `sell_assets`. The `buy_amount` is valid only when the `buy_asset` is defined.

fields.name: sell_delivery_method
fields.description: (optional) One of the `name` values specified by the `sell_delivery_methods` array for the associated asset returned from [`GET /info`](#info). Can be provided if the user is delivering an off-chain asset to the anchor but is not strictly required.

fields.name: buy_delivery_method
fields.description: (optional) One of the `name` values specified by the `buy_delivery_methods` array for the associated asset returned from [`GET /info`](#info). Can be provided if the user intends to receive an off-chain asset from the anchor but is not strictly required.

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: (optional) The [ISO 3166-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2) or [ISO-3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) code of the user's current address. Should be provided if there are two or more country codes available for the desired asset in [`GET /info`](#get-info).

fields.name: buy_assets
fields.description: An array of objects containing information on the assets that the client will receive when the `sell_asset` is provided.

fields.name: sell_assets
fields.description: An array of objects containing information on the assets that the client will receive when the `buy_asset` is provided.

fields.name: asset
fields.description: The [Asset Identification Format](#asset-identification-format) value.

fields.name: price
fields.description: The price offered by the anchor for one unit of `asset` in terms of `sell_asset`. In traditional finance, `asset` would be referred to as the base asset and `sell_asset` as the counter asset.

fields.name: decimals
fields.description: The number of decimals needed to represent `asset`.

fields.name: sell_asset
fields.description: The asset the client would like to sell. Ex. `USDC:G...`, `iso4217:ARS`

fields.name: buy_asset
fields.description: The asset the client would like to exchange for `sell_asset`.

fields.name: sell_amount
fields.description: The amount of `sell_asset` the client would like to exchange for `buy_asset`.

fields.name: buy_amount
fields.description: The amount of `buy_asset` the client would like to purchase with `sell_asset`.

fields.name: sell_delivery_method
fields.description: (optional) One of the `name` values specified by the `sell_delivery_methods` array for the associated asset returned from [`GET /info`](#info). Can be provided if the user is delivering an off-chain asset to the anchor but is not strictly required.

fields.name: buy_delivery_method
fields.description: (optional) One of the `name` values specified by the `buy_delivery_methods` array for the associated asset returned from [`GET /info`](#info). Can be provided if the user intends to receive an off-chain asset from the anchor but is not strictly required.

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: (optional) The [ISO 3166-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2) or [ISO-3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) code of the user's current address. Should be provided if there are two or more country codes available for the desired asset in [`GET /info`](#get-info).

fields.name: context
fields.description: The context for what this quote will be used for. Must be one of `sep6` or `sep31`.

fields.name: total_price
fields.description: The total conversion price offered by the anchor for one unit of `buy_asset` in terms of `sell_asset`, including fees. In traditional finance, `buy_asset` would be referred to as the base asset and `sell_asset` as the counter asset.

fields.name: price
fields.description: The conversion price offered by the anchor for one unit of `buy_asset` in terms of `sell_asset`, without including fees. In traditional finance, `buy_asset` would be referred to as the base asset and `sell_asset` as the counter asset.

fields.name: sell_amount
fields.description: The amount of `sell_asset` the anchor will exchange for `buy_asset`. It could be different from the `sell_amount` provided in the request, depending on how fees are applied by the Anchor.

fields.name: buy_amount
fields.description: The amount of `buy_asset` the anchor will provide with `sell_asset`. It could be different from the `buy_amount` provided in the request, depending on how fees are applied by the Anchor.

fields.name: fee
fields.description: An object describing the fee used to calculate the conversion price. This can be used to detail the price components for the end-user.

fields.name: total
fields.description: The total amount of fee applied.

fields.name: asset
fields.description: The asset in which the fee is applied, represented through the [Asset Identification Format](#asset-identification-format).

fields.name: details
fields.description: (optional) An array of objects detailing the fees that were used to calculate the conversion price. This can be used to detail the price components for the end-user.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the fee, for example `ACH fee`, `Brazilian conciliation fee`, `Service fee`, etc.

fields.name: description
fields.description: (optional) A text describing the fee.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: The amount of asset applied. If `fee.details` is provided, `sum(fee.details.amount)` should be equals `fee.total`.

fields.name: sell_asset
fields.description: Same as the definition of `sell_asset` in `GET /price`.

fields.name: buy_asset
fields.description: Same as the definition of `buy_asset` in `GET /price`.

fields.name: sell_amount
fields.description: Same as the definition of `sell_amount` in `GET /price`.

fields.name: buy_amount
fields.description: The same definition of `buy_amount` in `GET /price`.

fields.name: expire_after
fields.description: (optional) The client's desired `expires_at` date and time for the quote. Anchors may choose an `expires_at` that occurs after the `expire_after`. Anchors should return `400 Bad Request` if the an expiration on or after the requested value cannot be provided.

fields.name: sell_delivery_method
fields.description: (optional) One of the `name` values specified by the `sell_delivery_methods` array for the associated asset returned from [`GET /info`](#info). Must be provided if the user is delivering an off-chain asset to the anchor unless no more than one method is specified in the `GET /info` response.

fields.name: buy_delivery_method
fields.description: (optional) One of the `name` values specified by the `buy_delivery_methods` array for the associated asset returned from [`GET /info`](#info). Must be provided if the user intends to receive an off-chain asset from the anchor unless no more than one method is specified in the `GET /info` response.

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: (optional) The [ISO 3166-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2) or [ISO-3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) code of the user's current address. Should be provided if there are two or more country codes available for the desired asset in [`GET /info`](#get-info).

fields.name: context
fields.description: The context for what this quote will be used for. Must be one of `sep6`, `sep24` or `sep31`.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier for the quote to be used in other Stellar Ecosystem Proposals (SEPs).

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: The date and time by which the anchor must receive funds from the client.

fields.name: total_price
fields.description: The total conversion price offered by the anchor for one unit of `buy_asset` in terms of `sell_asset`, including fees. In traditional finance, `buy_asset` would be referred to as the base asset and `sell_asset` as the counter asset.

fields.name: price
fields.description: The conversion price offered by the anchor for one unit of `buy_asset` in terms of `sell_asset`, without including fees. In traditional finance, `buy_asset` would be referred to as the base asset and `sell_asset` as the counter asset.

fields.name: sell_asset
fields.description: The asset the client would like to sell. Ex. `USDC:G...`, `iso4217:ARS`

fields.name: sell_amount
fields.description: The amount of `sell_asset` to be exchanged for `buy_asset`. It could be different from the `sell_amount` provided in the request, depending on how fees are applied by the Anchor.

fields.name: sell_delivery_method
fields.description: (optional) The method by which the user plans to deliver an off-chain asset to the anchor. This will only be present if the parameter was specified in the associated `POST /quote` request.

fields.name: buy_asset
fields.description: The asset the client would like to exchange for `sell_asset`.

fields.name: buy_amount
fields.description: The amount of `buy_asset` to be exchanged for `sell_asset`. It could be different from the `buy_amount` provided in the request, depending on how fees are applied by the Anchor. `price * buy_amount = sell_amount` must be true up to the number of decimals required for `buy_asset`.

fields.name: buy_delivery_method
fields.description: (optional) The method by which the user plans to receive an off-chain asset from the anchor. This will only be present if the parameter was specified in the associated `POST /quote` request.

fields.name: fee
fields.description: An object describing the fee used to calculate the conversion price. This can be used to datail the price components for the end-user.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier for the quote. Same as the `id` returned in the [`POST /quote`](#post-quote) response.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The `id` specified in the request.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: The date and time by which the anchor must receive funds from the client.

fields.name: price
fields.description: The price offered by the anchor for one unit of `buy_asset` in terms of `sell_asset`. In traditional finance, `buy_asset` would be referred to as the base asset and `sell_asset` as the counter asset.

fields.name: sell_asset
fields.description: The asset the client would like to sell. Ex. `USDC:G...`, `iso4217:ARS`

fields.name: sell_amount
fields.description: The amount of `sell_asset` to be exchanged for `buy_asset`.

fields.name: sell_delivery_method
fields.description: (optional) The method by which the user plans to deliver an off-chain asset to the anchor. This will only be present if the parameter was specified at the time of quote creation.

fields.name: buy_asset
fields.description: The asset the client would like to exchange for `sell_asset`.

fields.name: buy_amount
fields.description: The amount of `buy_asset` to be exchanged for `sell_asset`. `price * buy_amount = sell_amount` must be true up to the number of decimals required for `buy_asset`.

fields.name: buy_delivery_method
fields.description: (optional) The method by which the user plans to receive an off-chain asset from the anchor. This will only be present if the parameter was specified at the time of quote creation.

fields.name: fee
fields.description: An object describing the fee used to calculate the conversion price. This can be used to datail the price components for the end-user.
